a.attack: Native summaries can be accidentally placed inside clickable section headers.
a.response: Use independent disclosure siblings and preserve existing collapse targets.
a.scoreReason: Native local disclosure gives a precise cross-surface implementation with dependable keyboard semantics.

b.attack: Global context folio is less concrete for complex form settings.
b.response: Apply local summaries to optional form groups.
b.scoreReason: Global context folio is less concrete for complex form settings.

revisedWinner.disclosed: Opened groups retain inclusion, duration, diagnostics and every metadata editor/link; existing menus retain their original subjects and callbacks.
revisedWinner.access: 44px native summaries, isolated events, visible keyboard focus, resilient text reflow and measured virtualized heights at zoom and 320px.
